fields.state: carried from CHECK-029 C029-11 and recomputed for 028b
fields.note: On the 028b section, the core reaches CR III W typical shear (35 psi) at 24.9 kPa (16 mm dimple) and at 37.8 kPa (9.3 mm), long before the elastic limit. A test article at those amplitudes will most likely fail by core shear on the dimple flank (r about 280-430 mm) before global collapse. Its measured pressure is then a core-strength capacity, and the outcome table records the mode with the value.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
